premise: On a cloudy morning Gull follows the fishing boat hoping for something tasty, but the net comes up full of nothing but seaweed, and Seaweed waves to her 'cousin'.
inspiration: The fisherman's-net folk tale (what will the net bring up?) with no wish and no greed: the catch is a cousin, and a laugh.
lesson: Not every surprise is the one you wanted, and that can be funny.

en-US.title: The Net Full of Surprises
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] It was a grey, cloudy morning. Soft clouds drifted over the bay. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Chug, chug… the fishing boat came out across the water. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Gull flew after it, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] hoping for something tasty. {seagull:face happy} The boat stopped. {fishing-boat:live} Up came the net, dripping and heavy. {seagull:live} {sfx:squawk} Gull squawked: what's in it? What's in it? [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Weed. Just a big, wet, green tangle of weed. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] Not far away, {seaweed:enter} Seaweed {seaweed:face happy} giggled. [playfully] Oh, look! That's my cousin! {seaweed:live} She swayed hello. {seagull:face happy} [laughs] Gull laughed so much she forgot all about being hungry. {fishing-boat:pulse} The fishing boat let the weed slip gently back into the water… {seaweed:hearts} and Seaweed waved until it was gone.

es-ES.title: La red llena de sorpresas
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.6 30s} [softly] Era una mañana gris y nublada. Unas nubes suaves pasaban sobre la bahía. {fishing-boat:enter} {fishing-boat:go to sea} Chuc, chuc… la barca de pesca salió por el agua. {fishing-boat:float loop 0.2} {seagull:enter} Gaviota voló detrás, {seagull:go to fishing-boat} [excited] esperando algo rico. {seagull:face happy} La barca se paró. {fishing-boat:live} Subió la red, chorreando y pesada. {seagull:live} {sfx:squawk} Gaviota graznó: ¿qué hay? ¿Qué hay? [short pause] {seagull:face surprised} Algas. Solo una gran maraña verde de algas. {seagull:face sad} [sighs] No muy lejos, {seaweed:enter} Alga {seaweed:face happy} se rió. [playfully] ¡Anda, mira! ¡Son mis primas! {seaweed:live} Se meció para saludar. {seagull:face happy} [laughs] Gaviota se rió tanto que se le olvidó el hambre. {fishing-boat:pulse} La barca devolvió las algas al agua con cuidado… {seaweed:hearts} y Alga las saludó hasta que se perdieron de vista.
